data.text:
Smt. Sakshi W/O Ravi Khatwani vs The State Of Maharashtra 
Thr. P. S.O., P. ... on 23 April, 2024 
Author: Vinay Joshi
Bench: Vinay Joshi
Order 
 1
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. 
 Criminal Application [Apl] No. 662/2024. 
 Smt. Sakshi Ravi Khatwani 
 -Versus-
 State of Maharashtra. 
Office notes, Office Memoranda of
Coram, appearances, Court's orders Court's or Judge's Orders
or directions and Registrar's orders. 
 Shri K.S. Motwani, Advocate for the Applicant. 
 Shri I.J. Damle, A.P.P. for the Non-applicant. 
 Coram : Vinay Joshi And
 Vrushali V. Joshi, Jj. 
 Date : April 23, 2024. 
 Heard. 
2. This is an application seeking to quash the charge sheet bearing Sessions Case No.32/2024
arising out of first information report bearing Crime No.246/2023 registered with Sindewahi Police
Station, District Chandrapur for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 of the Indian
Penal Code and Sections 26[i], 26[2][i], 26[2][iv], 27[3][e], 30[2][a] of the Food Safety Standards
Act, 2006. 
Rgd.

3.  Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 12.06.2024. Learned A.P.P. waives notice for the non-applicant. 
4. In the meantime the trial Court shall not insist for presence of the applicant except on the date of framing charge on condition that the applicant shall not challenge his identity. This order will remain in force till passing of further order in the matter.
